steps.label: Prompt
steps.text:
Make a high-energy 20-second launch video for [your product], 16:9 at 1920x1080, 30 fps, built on its real numbers.

Ask me first for the live stats worth showing (users, plays, sign-ups or anything else that is growing), and read [your product URL] to learn the product.

Story:
1. Hook: the biggest number, counting up.
2. The product on desktop and on mobile, side by side.
3. Its range: themes, modes or options, cycling on the beat.
4. Two more stats, then the logo and [your product URL].

Look and motion: high energy: rapid cuts on every beat, numbers that count up, bold type, with shake and flash saved for the biggest hits.

Sound: compose a short original track in code, or use a royalty-free one and tell me where it is from. Give every cut and reveal its own sound effect, land the cuts on the beat, and mix so nothing clips. If you cannot make the music in code, write me a prompt I can give a music generator instead, with the tempo and mood it should hit.

How to build it: draw every frame in code as a pure function of time (HTML, Canvas or SVG, Remotion or HyperFrames all work), render the frames headlessly and assemble an MP4 with the audio. Then watch your render at full speed and fix anything that feels slow, cramped, generic or off-brand before you hand it over.

original.label: Prompt
original.text: Create a high energy launch video, showing live stats from the website, show that users can play on desktop and mobile and multiple themes, if need, give me a prompt to generate the song using Suno

credit.note: Rewritten by us into a full brief for any product; their original is below.
